variants_and_exclusions: Some South Indian Shravana-name sets use Ju/Je/Jo/Kha where the north/Avakahada tradition treats these as Abhijit; v1 fixes one explicitly sourced 27-Nakshatra/108-pada Avakahada table, never mixes variants silently.
Roman t/d/n/tha/dha/sh sounds can represent distinct Devanagari consonants and different Rashis; Roman text never directly assigns an unconfirmed match.
Name given at a naming ceremony and common everyday name can differ. User chooses intended name, and spelling is never overwritten.
Conjunct-initial, unsupported scripts, or syllables not resolving uniquely must require manual traditional initial-syllable selection. Do not infer a Rashi from an arbitrary initial character.
Traditional vowel duration comparison is only a lookup equivalence; original spelling stays intact and unchanged.
The sign associated with a name is not a claim that the name was assigned based on birth Nakshatra, nor a verified Janma Rashi.
consent_and_privacy: Explicit unchecked consent to use the entered name locally
No network calls, persistent storage, personal-data analytics, or server submission from Nāma Rāśi resolver
No name included in existing birth-astronomy request
User can revoke consent without clearing the name field or changing birth result; no automatic horoscope output without consent
visible_guidance: A rashi-specific editorial reflection and one weekday-based prompt are clearly labelled non-transit, non-deterministic. Not a true date-specific astronomical rashifal until a separately governed transit/rule bank exists.
verification_required: Source table 27 rows x 4 = 108; 9 padas each Rashi
Devanagari name exact and vowel-variant matches
Roman consonant ambiguities blocked until user confirms Devanagari syllable
Names do not affect birth outputs, API bodies, or persistence
Consent denied/withdrawn shows no name-derived result
English/Hindi language and responsive mobile browser checks
Existing 34-check public frontend validation and Vercel build pass
governance_note: Do not advertise this as source-derived transit prediction, manipulate the existing AG75C birth-Nakshatra bank, or relabel it as Vedic-period authority.
